run_GTestColorTest: run the googletest color test suite to verify color output detection across TERM values
test_SetEnvVar: test the SetEnvVar function to set or unset environment variables like GTEST_COLOR
test_UsesColor: test the UsesColor function to check if gtest uses color output for a given TERM and flag
test_GTestColorTest_testNoEnvVarNoFlag: test color auto-detection behavior when neither GTEST_COLOR env var nor gtest_color flag is set
test_GTestColorTest_testAliasesOfYesAndN: test that gtest_color flag accepts aliases like true, YES, T, 1, false, 0, and unknown
